integrity: Proof-based theorem checked against independently solved finite discounted Dirichlet systems. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Wheel graphs with at least four rim vertices, simple random walks and common discount in (0,1); exact arithmetic for rational parameters. Existing path-gap and distance-domination tools imply portions of the result in special cases, but not the full wheel formula in inspected sources. Bibliographic completeness and independent verification remain open.
title: Balanced source placement and exact discounted hitting domination on wheel graphs
